The target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Medium or smaller creature and the rime worm doesn't have another creature grappled."}, {"name": "Freeze Prey", "desc": "One creature grappled by the rime worm must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be petrified in ice for 1 minute.
